items.prompt: A fair six-sided die is rolled twice. What is the probability that both rolls show an even number?
A raffle sells 200 tickets. One ticket wins $150, two tickets each win $25, and the rest win nothing. If you buy one ticket for $2, what is the expected net gain?
A bag holds 4 red, 3 blue, and 5 green marbles. One marble is drawn at random. What is the probability it is NOT green?
A spinner has 5 equal sectors: 2 are red, 2 are blue, and 1 is yellow. Event A = lands on red; Event B = lands on blue. Are A and B mutually exclusive, and what is P(A or B)?
A class has 10 boys and 15 girls. Two students are chosen one at a time without replacement. Given the first student chosen is a boy, what is the probability the second student is also a boy?
A spinner has 3 equal sectors labeled $1, $4, and $6. You pay $3 to spin once and win the amount shown. What is the expected net gain per spin?
